pages.text: Steep a spirit in a Preserving Jar with fruit or herbs and something sweet, lid closed: the whole jar becomes a liqueur, keeping the spirit's stars. Lemon peel and vodka: limoncello.
Spiced rum, aromatic bitters (a hangover cure), herbal liqueur, coffee liqueur, and a liqueur for most fruits. Whiskey steeped with apples and honey has a name of its own.
